---
title: "Himalayan Mountaineering Expeditions"
author: Sidney Langford
format: html
---

```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library("RColorBrewer")

exped_tidy <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-01-21/exped_tidy.csv')
peaks_tidy <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-01-21/peaks_tidy.csv')

```

```{r}
exped_tidy %>% 
  group_by(PEAKID) %>% 
  reframe(n = n(), PEAKID, SUCCESS1) %>% 
  filter(n > 35) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PEAKID, fill = SUCCESS1)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Pastel1") +
  labs(x = 'Peak', y = "Number of Attempts", fill = "Success", title = "Expedition Attempts and Successes of the Top 5 Most Popular Himalayan Peaks")
```
